name: Seltz
summary: Web search, cited answers, URL fetch, research agent runs and content monitors, scoped to web, news, wikipedia, people, companies or financial reports.

api_key.description: A Seltz API key (console.seltz.ai/api-keys). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Prices follow tier (search, fetch), model (answer) and effort (agent); unknown tier names are rejected rather than defaulted. New keys come with 20,000 search credits (seltz.ai).
Creating, editing and deleting monitors are writes and are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search the web for context
endpoints.summary: Ranked documents with content for a query, within one scope and optional date and domain filters.

max_results.description: Results to return, default 10; larger values are served as 1000.

scope.description: One of web (beta), news, wikipedia, people, companies, financial-reports; omitted searches the default scope.

tier.description: base (first-stage ranking) or pro (adds a reranking stage; the default). The value selects the price.

from_date.description: Published on or after: a date, a UTC datetime, or an offset like now-7d (units s, m, h, d, w, M, y).

to_date.description: Published on or before, same spellings as from_date.

endpoints.name: Answer a question with citations
endpoints.summary: An answer grounded in search results, with citations.

scope.description: One of web (beta), news, wikipedia, people, companies, financial-reports; omitted searches the default scope.

model.description: Answer tier, which sets behavior and billing; omitted is the default tier.

include_content.description: Citations carry the document text; default false.

system_prompt.description: Steers tone, voice and format of the answer.

response_format.description: OpenAI-style response_format object for structured output; no inline citations then.

stream.description: Stream as OpenAI-style SSE chunks; default false.

endpoints.name: Fetch URLs as Markdown
endpoints.summary: Main content of up to 20 URLs as Markdown, boilerplate removed.

urls.description: 1 to 20 distinct URLs, each at most 2048 bytes.

formats.description: Representations to return; only markdown is documented, and it is the default.

tier.description: Service tier, which selects the price; send pro (the default).

timeout_ms.description: Per-URL time budget in milliseconds; a URL over it gets error.code timeout.

notes: A read over POST. Invalid URL lists are rejected before billing.

endpoints.name: Start a research agent run
endpoints.summary: Starts a multi-round research run on a question; returns the run in pending state.

effort.description: Effort level, which sets how much research the run does and its price, e.g. low, medium, high, max.

output_schema.description: OpenAI-style response_format object requesting structured output.

notes: Asynchronous and billed by effort: poll seltz.agent.get with the returned id until status is completed, failed or cancelled.

endpoints.name: Get an agent run
endpoints.summary: A run's status and, once completed, its output and sources.
notes: Status moves pending, running, then completed, failed or cancelled.

before.description: Exclusive upper bound; pass the last monitor_id of the previous page.

endpoints.name: Read a monitor's records
endpoints.summary: New content a monitor has found, oldest first, as a record cursor.

limit.description: Default 100, max 1,000; a page can end early at a byte budget.

include_content.description: Include document content and properties; default true.

notes: Page by passing the last record_id as since.
